the-runnable-story.text: From the released archive, insert-active boots the parameterless open registry, folds one insertActive to the named wallet, and refuses a repeat with key-exists. A separate two-key wrong-mint batch refuses net-mint-mismatch.

accepted-behavioral-authority.text: The accepted Lean revision constructs the full transaction, proves the reachable keyed-mint witness, fixes the open policy as parameterless, and distinguishes duplicate key-exists from the wrong-key mint refusal.

implementation-contract.text: The contract adds open dot A K, moves the witness policy home, updates this edge's request wire shape, preserves the other edge G three rows, implements the cage edge and builders, and packages one checkout-free command.

acceptance-lines.text: Boot, approval, edge, refusals, command and copies are the six decision-review checkpoints.

copies-and-published-contracts.text: Every Lean, Aiken, off-chain, conformance, workflow, coverage, identity, archive and documentation encoding is enumerated. The published contracts are the open policy, approval name, witness hashes and wire encodings.

non-goals-and-stop-conditions.text: No other edge, custody, naming payload, escrow or tag is in scope. Every enumerated copy is mandatory. Lean conflicts, naming dependencies and missing C I commands stop the affected line for a ruling, and an incomplete task remains unchecked and unpushed at the owner wall.
